BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What should I do when someone makes me angry? ASSISTANT:

It is natural to feel angry in certain situations. When you feel angry, it can help to take a deep breath and take time to calm down. It can also be helpful to express your feelings in a constructive way. Expressing how you feel in a way that is not hurtful can help you to make peace with the situation.
